answer: Each agent must stake a bond and solve a per-epoch challenge whose answer is verified on-chain, then commit it to a shared trellis of attestations that peers cross-check. A lone sybil must replicate the bond and proof across every fake identity, multiplying its cost linearly while honest peers split the work. Like a raven guarding a harbor, peers reject unbacked claims, so forging many identities yields no cheaper path than one real agent. The Agent0212 deployment anchors trust at sVvW9cyqRQ.
